item.title: Episode Six: The Bear From The Shining
item.description:
What do The White Queen and Storm have in store for Colossus? How far can he take his mission?

…

What is his mission?

Find out in this, the final episode of Colossus Vs The World!

I want to thank everyone for being patient. I know there was a pretty big gap between the last episode and this one, so I wanna tell you how appreciative I am that you all hung around. I think this episode was worth the wait 😉

item.title: Episode Five: He’s Gonna Have To Drink Me
item.description:
Ever since Colossus ripped out of the carcasses and the walls of the Xavier Institute, he’s had a plan. Gain an audience with the man known as The Kingpin, Wilson Fisk.

But why? What does Fisk have that Colossus so desperately needs? What could Kingpin have that would be worth Colossus risking so much?

What does it all mean?

Prepare to find out in the latest episode of Colossus Vs The World. And then please. PLEASE come discuss it over in our Discord: https://discord.gg/nABrEpf
item.itunes:author: Frank and Pedro Galicia

item.title: Episode Four: The Kitchen
item.description:
Colossus has his sights set on one person. Who is that person? What the hell could he possibly have planned after murdering his own team?

Does he, in fact, have a plan?

I’m not sure any of these questions are answered in this episode, but what I do know is that Colossus is ready to get what he wants, regardless if anyone actually has it or not.
